rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when an internet, phone, or other connection is interrupted.

example.english: My internet connection can disconnect at any time.
example.traditional: 我屋企個網絡有時會斷線。
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 go3 mong5 lok6 jau5 si4 wui5 dyun6 sin3

rows.note: Use this when physically unplugging an appliance from the power source rather than when a connection merely stops working.

example.english: Remember to disconnect it by unplugging it before you leave.
example.traditional: 記住拔插頭先好出門口。
example.jyutping: gei3 zyu6 bat6 caap3 tau4 sin1 hou2 ceot1 mun4 hau2
